g.text: Robot homing · where the last GIGA run failed
Acquire Robot ownership → Prepare Home program → Run action.
Whole-robot ownership persists across all homing stages.
Stage 2 · M1 fails before homing can start
Proven failure point: new homing worker creation.
Which allocation or ThreadX operation failed is not recorded.
Total free heap after failure: 24,016 B across 15 free blocks.
That snapshot does not prove a sufficiently large usable block
or establish fragmentation as the cause.
M2 is never reached. M3 was reported referenced in this fixture.
The sequence is not a successful robot home.
Linux workflow success does not resolve this hardware/runtime failure.
Last flashed test pair bbe50064864223d7; motors disconnected and synthetic reference inputs.
Sequence is grounded in the log and current source. It does not identify the exact failing allocation or prove heap fragmentation.
